new_all_degree_arguments: The weight-zero pure and marked powers of every norm-one opposite-weight Hopf triple are explicit even polynomials C_m and B_m. An antiderivative with order-m derivative zero at1 proves their uniform integrals in every order.
Triangularity of1,C1,C2,... proves full pure nullity iff every even height moment is1/(2j+1). Under this condition the unweighted marker u itself has positive tail c_m.

The four phase pieces have weights kL and delta-depths0,2,4,6. Homogeneous b can change its first moment only at eight rational weight ratios;centre-evenness leaves five candidate weights per exceptional model in all polynomial degrees.

A smooth real height with bounded pushforward density on S2 has no degenerate critical points or saddles,by epsilon^(2/3),epsilon^(5/6) and epsilon*log(1/epsilon) mass lower bounds. Morse Euler then forces a unique minimum and maximum.

A noncyclic finite rotation group cannot preserve such a height. Real uniform-even moments force bounded density by symmetrization and compact real moment determinacy. Thus the whole real compact-height equivariant section branch is excluded.

For postcomposition by a regular SL2 self-map of actual H3 degree d,the additional Jacobian is mandatory:h(Jpsi*a(psi))=d*h(a). Prescribed polynomial/motivic degree does not by itself supply ordinary purity.
exact_controls: Six bounded coefficient identities and uniform integrals;antiderivative vanishing orders;four exact phase-piece depths;eight rational weight ratios and five even integral candidates per model;local area/exponent calculations;nonzero canonical compact-star differences.
logical_boundaries: Universal all-order algebra and smooth density/topology arguments remain internal written,not machine verified by the finite controls.
The five homogeneous weights are necessary candidates,not sufficient for purity. Mixed-weight b cannot be excluded componentwise by that list.
The real condition is on the auxiliary compact height. No assertion that purity forces reality,or that complex analytic moments determine a two-real-dimensional pushforward measure.
Only the torus-equivariant branch has the exact single-height criterion;arbitrary section parameters and the entire original exceptional MZ problems remain open.
The specified logarithmic height period is an all-order identity,not a sufficient finite moment prefix.
Polynomial self-map constructions retain a Jacobian and actual top-degree normalization. No postcomposition was claimed to solve unweighted purity.
